en.t: The next day, the lieutenant general sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“昨夜为了悼念旧侣，恋慕新人，只觉心绪烦乱，匆匆告别而归。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "Last night, grieving for an old companion and longing for a new beloved, I felt my heart in turmoil, and so I hurriedly took my leave and returned home.
